body.p: by the review agent (), who did not write Phase 1.

item.p: Rubric over include/sxml/ (all headers read), the evaluator, lowering, XDM, tree, XML parser and processor (sampled), the rest spot checked: names and glossary, at most three parameters (also every function-pointer type), lifecycle quintets (public and internal types complete), ownership, units, failure and thread safety in public headers, error codes (61 distinct, all well formed), spec citations. No writable file-scope data in libsxml, the CLI or the driver (release objects have empty .data and .bss; libmpdec's are vendored, ); no malloc/free outside src/allocator.c; no printing, abort or exit in src/.

through pointers: every indirect call in src/ was followed. Cell release re-enters sxml_cell_release from only to queue (a flat loop frees); concatenations are flattened, so a part is never a concatenation; the evaluator runs IR, native-row and coerced bodies as tasks and calls only map, array, constructor and host bodies directly; sxml_evaluator_call_function_item refuses a running context; arena-tree and tree-builder operations never call back into tree.c; tree owners only destroy; generators, resolvers and output streams are the host's. tools/check-call-cycles.py now also links the QT4 driver (with the CLI framework) as a second program: 85 files, no cycle.

CI cannot run: every GitHub Actions job since 2026-10-16 is refused ("recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased"); the last green run is 38931572793 (Phase 0 gate). All gate checks were run locally (Linux x86-64, Clang and GCC, WASI SDK 34 on Node 22): presets debug, debug-gcc, , wasm, fuzz, lint, slice, fuzzing, dashboard (numbers in LOG). macOS, Windows and MSVC are unverified since the Phase 0 gate: an open gate risk, not ticked. The CI boxes of the gate stay open until the owner restores billing and a run is green.
